topic: The Physics of Pi: Colliding Blocks and Digit Emergence
target_audience: University students with a basic understanding of Newtonian mechanics

sections.title: The Hook: An Unexpected Discovery
lecture_lines: Consider two blocks sliding toward a wall.
Small block m hits large block M.
Collisions produce digits of Pi. Amazing!
animations: Fade in Block 'm' (color #4169E1) and Block 'M' (color #FF4500) on the screen.
Move Block 'm' toward Block 'M' and collide them.
Show collision count display (incrementing) in white (#FFFFFF) above the blocks.

sections.title: Prerequisite Physics: Conservation Laws
lecture_lines: Collisions conserve both momentum and energy.
Velocity updates define a system of equations.
Phase space plots show circular paths.
animations: Display Kinetic Energy 'K' and Momentum 'P' in soft green (#90EE90).
Show velocity vector 'v' equation update with animated labels. Color: #FFA500.
Animate a point traversing a circle to demonstrate energy conservation. Color: #32CD32.

sections.title: Geometric Mapping: The Circle Connection
lecture_lines: Map velocity states onto a circle.
Each collision rotates the velocity vector.
Collision count relates to arc length.
Geometric mapping explains this Pi connection.
animations: Display unit circle with velocity vector at angle theta. Color: #FFFFFF.
Rotate vector by collision angle. Color: #FFFF00.
Project vector onto axis to form arc segments. Color: #A9A9A9.
Highlight cumulative arc length 's' on the circle circumference. Color: #FF4500.
Label the arc length 'Pi' to link geometry to result. Color: #FFD700.

sections.title: Scaling Powers of 100
lecture_lines: Increase mass ratio by powers of 100.
Observe collision counts matching Pi digits.
animations: Animate the growth of collision count digits in a row. Color: #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Conclusion and Intuition
lecture_lines: Phase space rotations yield discrete counts.
Geometry and physics are deeply linked.
animations: Fade in Phase Space diagram showing circular trajectories. Color: #FFFFFF.
Flash the intersection of geometry and physics nodes. Color: #00FFFF.
Fade out all elements to black background.
